title: Yang Sin Teh

page_data.en:
C. I. O.
F. O. REG
No. 679
Date 3/11/46

Translation of a letter from the Shanghai
Military Governor to C.D.I.Armstrong.

Sungkiang and Shanghai Military
Commissioner's yamen.
June 27,

Yesterday you called at this yamen and stated that
a Chinese named Kau had requested a Japanese of
320 Chapoo Road to order another Japanese residing at
1 Quinsan Road to print on his behalf notes on the
Hupeh Provincial Bank. I appreciated your information
and at once wired to Chiangchun Wong and Civil Governor
Van at Wuchang. A reply has been received from them
to the effect that the Hupeh province have not ordered
any such notes to be printed and that those found here
must be forgeries.

In view of this I specially write to you in the
hope that you will take note and adopt measures
to effect the arrest of the parties concerned and bring
them before the Mixed Court for trial in order that
they may be handed over to this yamen for final
decision.

Meanwhile let me express my appreciation for
your friendly cooperation and with compliments,

I am, etc,

(signed) Yang Sin Teh.
page_data.zh:
首席情报官
外交部登记处
第 679 号
日期：1946年11月3日

上海军事长官致 C.D. Armstrong 上校（首席侦探督察）信函的译文。

松江与上海军事专员公署。
6月27日，

昨日阁下莅临本公署，称一名姓高的华人请求住在乍浦路320号的一名日本人，令另一名居住在昆山路1号的日本人为其代印湖北省银行钞票。本人对阁下提供的情报表示感谢，并立即致电武昌的蒋春旺（音译）及范民政长官。已收到他们的复电，大意是湖北省并未下令印制此类钞票，此处发现的必系伪钞。

有鉴于此，本人特致函阁下，希请留意并采取相应措施，将涉案人员逮捕，送交混合法庭受审，以便将其移交本公署作最终裁决。

同时，本人对阁下的友好合作表示赞赏，顺致敬意。

此致，

（签名）杨新德（音译）
